question: Using data from ChEMBL Release 23, retrieve all distinct molecules associated with the company 'SanofiAventis,' listing the trade name and the most recent approval date for each molecule. Make sure to keep only the latest approval date per molecule and ensure the company field precisely matches 'SanofiAventis' without relying on other fields.
sql:
WITH sanofi_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ms.molregno
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.research_companies_23` rc
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms ON rc.res_stem_id = ms.res_stem_id
    WHERE rc.company = 'SanofiAventis'
),
molecule_info AS (
    SELECT 
        md.molregno,
        md.pref_name,
        MAX(md.first_approval) as first_approval
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_dictionary_23` md
    JOIN sanofi_molecules sm ON md.molregno = sm.molregno
    GROUP BY md.molregno, md.pref_name
),
trade_names AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.molregno,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ms.synonyms, ', ' ORDER BY ms.synonyms) as trade_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms
    JOIN sanofi_molecules sm ON ms.molregno = sm.molregno
    WHERE ms.syn_type = 'TRADE_NAME'
    GROUP BY ms.molregno
)
SELECT 
    mi.molregno,
    mi.pref_name,
    tn.trade_name,
    mi.first_approval
FROM molecule_info mi
JOIN trade_names tn ON mi.molregno = tn.molregno
ORDER BY mi.molregno
